patterns.title: Hybrid Executive Brand Sync Across Web, Visual Guides & Phone/Tablet/Laptop Viewports
patterns.standard_playbook: Synchronize /neurohands, LINE Rich Menus, and HTML-to-PNG visual guide cards on Midnight Navy (#060D28), Electric Cyan (#0F8CE8/#38BDF8), and Crisp White (#FFFFFF) with mission 'From Thailand to the World — Helping humans learn and grow.'
patterns.guardrail_rule: Match 1200x628 visual guide cards with aspect-ratio 1200/628 object-fit:contain, verify zero horizontal overflow at 390px, 768px, and 1440px, and keep mobile sticky headers compact with scroll-margin-top >= 148px.
